title: Migrate Task documents serially under the accepted HarnessTask contract
objective: After the HarnessTask field, wire, rendering-input, comparison, review-packet, and compatibility contract is completed and human-accepted, implement that unchanged contract and migrate the six selected Task files exactly one at a time with one durable human disposition per file.
authorized_scope: The selected source paths are exactly .pi/tasks/harness.simplification.docs-json.md, .pi/tasks/harness.simplification.docs-json.publication.md, .pi/tasks/harness.simplification.docs-json.publication.triage.md, .pi/tasks/harness.simplification.docs-json.publication.hierarchy.md, .pi/tasks/harness.simplification.docs-json.authority-catalog.md, and .pi/tasks/harness.simplification.docs-json.documentation-correction.md.

Begin only after harness.simplification.docs-json.task-model-contract is completed and its frozen field and rendering contract has an explicit human-acceptance record; consume that exact accepted contract without silently adding fields or changing ownership.

Implement the accepted HarnessTask, canonical serializer and deserializer, graph validator, explicit documentation-content and projection inputs, Markdown renderer, exact comparator and result, source mapping, migration review packet, file disposition recording, compatibility behavior, schemas, fixtures, public imports, tests, and maintained documentation.
Keep the current chain operational and preserve mixed Markdown/JSON TaskRecordAdapter compatibility plus exact TaskStateInspector behavior throughout migration.

For each of the six exact source files, prepare one immutable review packet containing source identity and bytes, accepted-contract mappings, candidate JSON, explicit documentation-content input, projection profile, rendered Markdown, exact comparison findings, opaque-block treatment, and unmapped spans, then stop for one durable human disposition.

Apply only the currently accepted file migration, verify canonical JSON round trip, exact accepted Markdown rendering, graph and compatibility behavior, retained evidence and rollback identity, and only then prepare the next file.

If a file reveals a required HarnessTask schema or rendering-contract change, stop migration without modifying that contract and route the issue to a separately reviewed task-model-contract revision decision.
completion_criteria: The exact accepted Stage-1 contract identity is recorded and unchanged by Stage 2, and every implemented public surface, schema, fixture, test, and maintained document agrees with it.

Each selected file has exactly one immutable packet and one exact human disposition; no later packet is prepared before the current disposition and accepted migration verification are durably recorded.

No accepted file packet silently expands or changes HarnessTask fields, canonical JSON, renderer inputs, mapping semantics, opaque-content ownership, or comparison policy; required changes stop and return to contract revision.
LaTeX, Mermaid, code fences, directives, tables, links, and other opaque project content remain byte-identical unless the exact file disposition accepts a stated transformation.

All six Tasks remain exactly inspectable under mixed Markdown/JSON compatibility, and every accepted file passes canonical round trip, complete rendering, exact comparison, graph validation, projection, rollback-identity, and focused software-verification checks.

One independent review is completed, every material finding receives an explicit disposition, every correction receives deterministic verification, and no material finding remains unresolved; an initial failed review remains recorded as failed and no repeated review loop is authorized.

All six file migrations are human-dispositioned and verified, but the current chain remains operational authority and no selection-state implementation, chain cutover, deletion, or successor activation occurs.
exclusions: Do not activate before the Stage-1 Task-model contract is completed and human-accepted, and do not implement or migrate while this Task status is blocked.
Do not batch-approve files, infer approval from silence or checks, prepare a later packet early, or alter the accepted model contract inside a file migration.
Do not normalize, reflow, reinterpret, or silently drop LaTeX, Mermaid, code fences, directives, tables, links, opaque blocks, documentation-owned narrative, or historical evidence.

Do not implement candidate selection state, cut over or delete the chain, migrate Tasks outside the six selected files, add dependencies, change lockfiles, or perform SQLite, telemetry, scientific, publication, external, protected, or release work.
